Luther.scope: The 66-book Luther 1545 numbering represented by the LUTH1545STR Zefania edition dated 2009-01-20. This is an explicit edition profile, not an alias for all German Bibles or all Luther revisions. Apocrypha and other edition layouts have not been verified.

KJV.scope: Verified KJV conversion for the 66-book canon, including unnumbered Psalm titles. Retains all 80 legacy KJV book counts; Apocrypha conversion remains unsupported. Numbering correspondence does not assert identical wording or textual variants.

compiledReferenceCoverage.scope: Whole numbered reference verses and declared verse-zero titles; represented includes atomic groups and ambiguous relationships, not proof of text coverage.

VLT.scope: VLT v3 New Testament numbering in the 167,161-row OET input word table. Original NT chapter/verse divisions with PHP 1:16-17 in KJV order. This is an explicit source profile, not an alias for every Greek text or for the OET Old Testament.

scope: Raw structural findings plus separately labelled compiled reference coverage. Compiled coverage includes the BOS supplement and declared delta identities; neither section certifies text equivalence or resolves custom inheritance.

DAG.reason: Greek Daniel is a target of org mappings but has no org count definition. Use the lxx 12-chapter layout as a provisional Greek composite view. Shared Hebrew passages and Greek additions require an explicit bridge; this is not a new independent copy of those passages.

LAO.reason: Letter to the Laodiceans has 20 verses in both vul and eng; use the Latin-tradition source. No cross-tradition mapping is asserted.

6EZ.reason: Latin 6 Ezra has a two-chapter definition. Its relationship to the larger Ezra/Esdras works needs a verified bridge.

1MQ.reason: Only this snapshot supplies these Meqabyan counts. The enclosing custom file is incomplete/underspecified; verify the edition and completeness before conversion.

3MQ.reason: Only this snapshot supplies these Meqabyan counts; 2 Meqabyan remains absent. Verify the edition and completeness before conversion.

REP.reason: Provisional Ethiopian Reproof counts; verify the edition and completeness before conversion.

4BA.reason: Provisional 4 Baruch counts; verify the edition and completeness before conversion.
